obligations.statement: Concurrent access and lifetime transition of the singleton instance must be protected by a consistent synchronization policy.
obligations.guard_relation: all instance publication, reset and use paths share a proven synchronization boundary
obligations.effect: prevents an instance reset from racing with a stale instance use
limitations: The historical sample does not by itself prove product reachability or a particular lock policy.

obligations.statement: A pointer or reference obtained before reset must not be dereferenced after the owned instance is destroyed.
obligations.guard_relation: lifetime ownership and alias use are ordered and rebinding is proven when required
obligations.effect: prevents use-after-free of the previous singleton instance
limitations: Static candidate shape is not runtime concurrency proof.
